In Maine, you can buy alcohol as early as **5:00 AM** every day of the week, including Sundays. This applies to both on-premises (restaurants/bars) and off-premises (liquor stores/grocery stores with liquor licenses) sales. 

Maine is known for having relatively liberal alcohol sale hours compared to many other states - all days operate with the same 5:00 AM to 1:00 AM window, with no special restrictions on Sundays like some other states have.
